CastLine.description: One cast this beat (public). A fizzled cast has `fizzled` and no row.

fault_factor.description: Rules 0.8.0, megas only: the fault rule's damage multiplier (radius and magnitude scale with it).

fault_km.description: Rules 0.8.0, megas only: distance (km) from where it struck to the nearest fault line.

fizzled.description: Why it fizzled (not enough bolts, no such target); nothing was spent.

icon.description: The power's icon key (= its slug for palette powers).

off_target.description: Entropy ≥ 40: physics threw it off its aim.

place.description: The most specific place it struck (a city, or the region).

seq.description: Its action's room-wide arrival order (0 for the built-in AI, which casts first).

target.description: What it hit directly, or null (a point).

tier.description: Rules 0.7.0: mega (cost a bolt) or mini (cost a spark).

ChallengeEnd.description: Rules 0.8.1: a duel over, applied at the resolve (`round.outcome.public.duels[]`).

deed.description: One line: the duel mind's, else the rules'.

log.description: The blows this final resolve was handed (earlier ones came live and in challenge.open).

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: the rest of its panels, through the outro (`starts_at_ms` may lie ahead: play them out).

pos.description: `at` at full precision (outcome numbers are rounded to 2 decimals except `pos`).

ChallengeOpen.description: Rules 0.8.1: a duel still under way after this resolve (`round.outcome.public.duels_open[]`; the damage so far is applied).

log.description: The blows this resolve was handed.

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: the panels this resolve made due (some may have come live already: key them by `n`).

DayPhase.description: Rules 0.8.0: the phase of the game day.

DiceRolled.description: Rules 0.8.0: one d20 the DM rolled (seeded, recorded: the same question always gives the same roll).

reason.description: What it was for, in public words ("a strike", "a monster encounter", "manifesting a relic").

verdict.description: A natural 1 is crit_fail, a natural 20 crit_success, else total vs DC.

DmEvent.description: Rules 0.8.0: one public decision of the DM this beat: `event` (settlement.grew, settlement.shrank, settlement.building, encounter.marked, encounter.revealed, encounter.faded, loot.dropped, loot.taken, road.formed, road.faded, shrine.built, shrine.level, story.scar, story.wardrobe, story.followers, time.phase), `text` (one line), `memory` (its memory entry id) and the decision's own fields (docs/CLIENT_API.md).

DuelBlow.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` for each duel line, at once (also in the resolve's challenge.open / challenge.end log).

also.description: Rules 0.8.2 (live event only): the panels this line's stamp made due. Handle each as its own event.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

DuelPanel.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.panel`, one comic panel of a duel: the presentation of the blows of one input window (they are decided by the 0.8.1 rules; a panel decides nothing). Sent in `also[]` of the action that made it due, as the event of a `duel_tick`, in `challenge.open` / `challenge.end`, and all of them in `present.duels[].panels`.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

also.description: Live event only: further panels made due by the same action.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

blows.description: The `n` of each duel.blow it stages.

on.description: `a` / `b` (the fighter hit) or a scene object's id.

input_closes_ms.description: starts_at_ms + play_ms - 700 (the render lead); null: no input (a knockout, the last slot, the outro). Lines stamped up to it feed panel n + 1.

ko.description: Outro only: the side knocked out.

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: the previous panel's end.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

Entropy.description: The world's Entropy meter. Every bolt spent anywhere raises it; thresholds make the world wackier (20 weather, 40 physics, 60 riots, 80 godfall); at `max` heat death makes that beat the Final Night.

heat_death.description: The beat heat death struck, or null.

next_at.description: The value of the next threshold (max at the top level).

text.description: What this level does to the world, one line.

GodPowerLine.description: Rules 0.8.0: a god-tier power this beat. A fizzled one has `fizzled` and nothing was spent.

ImageObject.description: An image the media server attached (only when the server has images on; see docs/MEDIA.md). Fetch `url` once `status` is `ready` (watch GET /media/index for `hash`); `off` = none will come, show a placeholder.

hash.description: Content key (sha256 hex): cache by it forever.

prompt.description: The full prompt sent to the image model (house style; no engine ids).

url.description: `/media/<hash>.<ext>` once ready, relative to the server's HTTP origin.

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

Manifestation.description: Rules 0.7.0: one manifestation attempt (made or not).

request.description: Your own only: kind, count, magnitude.

verdict.description: Your own only: outcome, tier, odds {success, twist, partial, backfire, terms}, roll, cost {required, bolts, extra, missing, debt}, god, favor, entropy, reasons, flavor.

Omen.description: A god's ruling as a client sees it (public omens and your own invocations).

god_ref.description: The god's ref (`gd:<n>`; the table is in round.brief.public.gods).

speech.description: What the god said. Never starts with the god's name (render `god` yourself).

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

SlowEvent.description: One slow-time announcement this beat: a window that closed since the last beat (with Time's bill), or orders sent without a window (an instant Enter, billed as a zero-second slow). A window still open is announced by the core (`window.opened`, `match.snapshot.window`) and the `slowed` phase.event.

after_ms.description: closed / instant: how long time was slowed (real ms: from the window's opening to the Enter's arrival, or the deadline; 0 for instant).

debt.description: closed / instant: the debt Time wrote (0 if the initiator had fallen).

event.description: closed (settled now), or orders without a window.

how.description: closed only: the initiator's submit (Enter), or the deadline (the opener is billed the full slow even if nobody submitted).

paid_bolt.description: closed / instant: Time got its bolt (if not, the debt doubled).

text.description: "<name> slowed time", the closing line, or the instant-Enter line.

TimeOfDay.description: Rules 0.8.0: the time of day (`beats_per_day` beats a day).

WorldEvent.description: A public, geotagged world event (one ledger row): casts and their ramifications, armies raised, marching and fighting, freak weather, world mods, wounded gods, eliminations.

image.description: A moment card: only on events the media style's event_selection picks (and only with images on).

image_prompt.description: Every public event: its image subject (a candidate moment card; it names who is in it with their visual sheets). Older recordings: only the big ones.

kind.description: The row's verb: cast, happen, march, raise_army, shrink, damage, mood_shift, mod, unmod, wound, eliminate...

description: `round.outcome.public`: what everyone sees after the beat resolves. The narrator runs one beat late (off the critical path), so the narration here describes beat `caption_beat` (the previous beat), not `beat`.

caption.description: Same text as `previous_caption` (kept for older clients).

caption_beat.description: The beat `previous_caption` / `previous_callouts` describe (beat - 1); null on the first beat.

casts.description: Every cast this beat, in the order settled.

dice.description: Rules 0.8.0: every d20 the DM rolled this beat (at most 60), in order.

dm_events.description: Rules 0.8.0: the DM's public decisions this beat (at most 40): settlements growing, encounters, loot, roads, shrines, scars, the time of day.

duels.description: Rules 0.8.1: the duels that ended this beat (absent when none).

duels_open.description: Rules 0.8.1: duels still under way (absent when none).

eliminated.description: Names of demigods that fell during this beat's resolve.

events.description: Public geotagged world events this beat, in order (<= 40). Rules 0.8.0: a summoning adds its `summoned` event here too (`kind` and `event` "summoned", `at` its landing; see DmEvent).

god_powers.description: Rules 0.8.0: god-tier powers settled this beat (each then ruled on by its god: see `omens`).

manifests.description: Rules 0.7.0: public manifestations this beat (made things of tier relic or up, or legend+ attempts).

omens.description: Public god rulings this beat (magnitude >= 6, or one that sent a paladin; Entropy's yes to every cast of magnitude >= 6).

players_alive.description: Rules 0.7.0: players with a demigod standing.

previous_callouts.description: 0-3 short asides for beat `caption_beat` (god quips, kill lines). Without the LLM these repeat the omen speeches.

previous_caption.description: The narrator's caption for beat `caption_beat` ("" on the first beat). Template text when the LLM is off or late.

slow.description: Slow-time announcements this beat (open / closed / instant).

society.description: The society's public summary (schema 4). Its shape is not frozen yet (the society build is in progress); read defensively.

summons.description: Rules 0.8.0: the `summoned` events of this beat (also in dm_events): {demigod, from {pos, cell}, to {pos, cell}, deed, health_lost}.

timing.description: Server-side wall-clock timings of the resolve (diagnostics).

llm_fallbacks.description: Of those, how many used their rules fallback.

society_dropped.description: Society events dropped from the payload.

society_emerged.description: People who emerged from the simulation this beat.
